surface_mechanism_description: The actual mechanism of ELD Cu deposition is believed to involve a hydride transfer from glyoxylic acid at the catalytic surface. Some of the generated H2 shown in Reaction 2 still remains in the vicinity of the side walls, indicated with arrows on the top of Fig. 4a, which results in reduced Cu growth because the Cu does not stick on the Pd/TaN substrate where H2 is present.
